[tp-asciidoc-viewer%allow-script,label="tp-mathfield"]
========
[script,type="tp/asciidoc"]
----
.Basic usage
======
[tp-mathfield%clearable,label="Formula",value="E = mc^2"]
====
====
======

.Javascript API
======
[script,type="module"]
====
import "/components/math/math.js";
import "/components/mathfield/mathfield.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-mathfield");
element1.setAttribute("label", "Formula");
element1.setAttribute("value", "E = mc^2");
element1.setAttribute("clearable", "");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
====
======

.Inline in prose
======
Einstein's equation [tp-mathfield,value="E = mc^2"]#energy# relates mass and energy.
======

.Inline named field
======
Value: [tp-mathfield,value="E = mc^2",placeholder="Enter a value"]#identifier#
======
